author: cost_peer specialist

scope.canonical_title: Private equity, venture capital and entrepreneurship

coverage.lbo: Dated enterprise/equity price bridge, acquisition uses/sources including seller cash and old debt retirement, third-party fees, required operating versus excess cash, positive taxable profit and interest sequencing, annual minimum principal and sweeps, original dated funding failure and explicit repair, full lender/sponsor cash closure, exit fee and residual debt, MOIC and IRR.
coverage.value_attribution: Derived earnings-then-multiple enterprise change and sponsor cash-gain decomposition; entry-price sensitivity, debt paydown funded by prior operating cash and separate later sponsor contribution. Contractual path yield is not asserted to price actual credit risk or create free leverage value.
coverage.venture_rounds: Derived issue price and pre-round option-pool denominator with feasibility condition; two original rounds close actual share counts and fully diluted fractions. Distinguishes reserve from current ownership, specified granted/vested/zero-price exercised awards at exit, primary versus secondary cash, down-round dilution without invented anti-dilution protection and headline valuation versus common fair value.
coverage.preferred: Original two-class senior/junior 1x nonparticipating contract with class conversion choice and exact joint-regime proof including low exits, tie cash, inconsistent B-only conversion region and all common recipients. Separately derives one-class nonparticipating, participating and capped-participating-plus-conversion payoffs.
coverage.entrepreneurship: Staging, milestones, conditional financing, verification, control versus economic ownership and funding risk. Personal opportunity cost and risk concentration taught with original supplied-certainty-equivalent comparison.
coverage.fund: Dated LP calls/investments/fee receipts/gross portfolio proceeds/returned LP capital/LP profit/GP carry under explicit whole-fund terms. No unmodeled hurdle, catch-up, GP co-investment or borrowing. Gross versus net IRR/MOIC, unused commitments, mark-based carry accrual and net DPI/RVPI/TVPI close.
coverage.evidence: Separate subscription-line example reconciles lender and LP dates and demonstrates higher LP IRR with lower multiple and unchanged investment return. Source-scoped sample selection, reporting, survivorship, realization, vintage, risk, access and benchmark limitations; no private-market outperformance guarantee.

resolved_findings.resolution: run() now requires all five base fractions and preferred investment amounts. Added exact changed 5,000 / 3,000 common-holder rejection, documented the bounded contract, and reran focused checker.

resolved_findings.finding: A final-date top-up netted against exit proceeds would distort a multiple based on net cash signs.

limits: Author review is not acceptance or independent human certification. Root alone changes shared state, accepts prerequisites, integrates checkers/sources, builds and publishes.
No complete cross-library build, browser visual/mobile/print review or deployment performed by specialist. Focused fragment and numeric checks cover only assigned package.

LBO assumes positive taxable profit, supplied financing terms, annual timing and positive residual debt through sweeps; early repayment distributions, default recovery, loss-tax regimes and refinancing require different inputs/methods.

Waterfall is a two-class stipulated voluntary-conversion game with fixed Saffron ownership, no side payments or extra claims. It does not establish a universal preferred valuation or arbitrary-cap-table solver.

Fund is fully liquidated, calls precede receipts and fees/carry are specified. Interim NAV allocation is a liquidation-mark convention, not a general fair-value theorem; neither historical sources nor original cases establish current market performance.
